messages:
Ava: Completely unimportant poll: if you could keep exactly ONE kitchen gadget forever (it never breaks, never goes missing), what would you choose? 
Ravi: Sandwich press. Paninis for life. 
Tess: Air fryer. Crisp without babysitting. :sparkles:
Noah: My kettle. Fast water = tiny miracles. 
Diego: Pasta pot with strainer lid. Boil + drain = efficiency.
Ava: @Tess, @Ravi, @Noah great picks. Bonus: explain one weird use that makes it irreplaceable.
Ravi: Sandwich press = quesadillas and grilled cheese innovation hour. Also works as a heavy lid for pan-searing.
Tess: Air fryer makes roasted chickpeas and revives stale croissants. Also the oven's lazy cousin.
Noah: Kettle is a stealth sterilizer. Pour boiling water down the sink occasionally and watch the germs run. (Not a doctor tip lol)
Diego: Pot+strainer = fewer dishes. Also makes great emergency hat? (jk)
KitchenBot: Friendly reminder: kitchen etiquette 3065 - label your containers.
Ava: Office event idea: "The Gadget Swap" at Friday coffee — bring your gadget, demo 3-minute hack, and we'll vote. Prize: sticker + eternal bragging rights.
Tess: I will demonstrate freezing croissant air-fryer hack.
Ravi: I can bring a stack of tortillas for panini experiments.
Noah: I'll bring fancy tea and kettle accessories.
Diego: I'll bring pasta. Compromise = carb fest.
Ava: Vote tally so far (informal): Air fryer 1, Sandwich press 1, Kettle 1, Pasta pot 1. Highly scientific.
Tess: Also, who else thinks an immersion blender is secretly the MVP? 
Ravi: I will admit it blends soups AND makes single-serve mayo. Sneaky.
Ava: OK see you Friday 10:30 in the kitchen. This thread will self-destruct into crumbs of croissant crumbs. :croissant:
KitchenBot: Lunchroom cleanup checklist posted in #help-kitchen.
Diego: Whoever wins has to write a tiny plaque for the gadget. :medal_sports:
